name: Avatar
description: A person's picture, or their initials when there's no picture, with an optional presence dot.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's name: the image's alt text and the source of the initials.

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL. Initials show when it's missing.

props.name: status
props.description: Presence dot, announced through the accessible name.

a11y: The image's alt is the person's name; initials get role="img" with the name as aria-label.
Presence is included in the accessible name, not only shown by color.
